description: Which geospatial-grpc markdown is part of the Open Knowledge Format bundle, and which is deliberately not. Consumed by scripts/check-okf-bundle.py.

spec.name: Open Knowledge Format
spec.note: One markdown file is one concept; the file path is the concept's identity; relative markdown links are the graph edges. `type` is the only required frontmatter field.

workstream: WS9 — the other nine repositories. geospatial-grpc is first: six pages, and the protocol every Honua client depends on.

conceptTypes.index: A section entry point. Enumerates what the directory holds so a reader or agent can choose before opening.
conceptTypes.concept: What a thing is and how it fits. No procedure.
conceptTypes.guide: A task someone performs, start to finish.
conceptTypes.reference: Lookup material: surfaces, options, contracts, matrices.

excludedFiles.why: The release-coordination contract between maintainers of this repo and the downstream SDKs. It describes how a change gets cut, not what the protocol is or how to consume it. A client reading the bundle should never need it.

How this repository publishes its generated Python and TypeScript clients from the immutable version tag. Publication mechanics for maintainers; the consumer-facing half of the same subject is the install step in getting-started.md.

rejectedFields.timestamp: Not an OKF field in any version. The trust family spells the build stamp `generated`. Rejected by name here so the v0.1-shaped mistake honua-site shipped until 2026-09-10 cannot spread into this bundle.

boundaryNote: This repository ships the protocol, not a server. Its bundle is therefore small and sharply split: what a client needs to consume geospatial.v1 is in, and how maintainers cut a release is out. The four included pages are the entry point (features/README.md), the on-ramp (getting-started.md), the contract (specification.md), and the ownership rule that tells downstream repos not to fork the protos (proto-ownership.md).
